source.section: 4. Cross-reference to Obs 272 — Cross-run disagreement (range 100–125 m)

claims.claim_text: ### Cross-run disagreement (range 100–125 m)

values.quantity: per-run attractor-pull cutoff, lower end of the cross-run disagreement range (T=0.3 text-HIGH and text-MIN)
per-run attractor-pull cutoff, upper end of the cross-run disagreement range (T=0.7 text-HIGH and image)

claims.notes: [BATCH NOTE b068] Scope decisions applied throughout this batch (lines 117–161; b067 covers 1–116). (a) Bracketed shell-interval notation — "(0, 50]", "(100, 125]", "(125, 150]" — is treated as a bin identifier (a name) rather than a fresh claim, because the shell edge set is asserted once at line 31, outside this batch, and re-extracting the same edges eight times would flood triage; where a bare radius is asserted as a cap, cutoff, or floor it IS extracted. (b) Run labels "T=0.3", "T=0.7", "text-HIGH", "text-MIN" are condition names per instrument rule 5 and are not extracted, except at line 143 where "at T = 0.7" asserts the image run's decoding temperature. (c) "55-map" is extracted as a map count per the "487-tile Era 2 corpus" precedent in rule 5, anchored to the distinct map_name count in the 55-map evaluation bounds; if triage judges it a pure name, every such value prunes together. This heading asserts the span of per-run cutoff_m values across the four runs.
